lines.text:
This world is so similar to mine.
No wonder it makes me sick.
Heh, rust buckets like these have humans on the ropes. How painfully pathetic.
I've stumbled into quite an irksome place.

Revenge does not discriminate.
It is the greatest equalizer.

I will kill EVE and prove myself to him again.
This is what I must do.

I need to go back.
There is something I must do there.

The air, the scenery...
Everything about this place gets on my nerves.

What a desolate place, with no traces of life.
I like it.

What is this place?
It's so noisy and bright. I hate it.
Hmmph. Just look at all these people prancing about.
I'm going back. I don't belong here.
Everything I do is for him.
Is this growth... How long has it been since I've felt something like this?
Hehe, yes, that's it. Give me more. More!
Oh... Can I become stronger?
I don't need this.
Get rid of this.
What is this?
Hmm...
Bah. How useless.
Ha. You can try and flatter me all you want. It's no use.
I draw my sword only in service to him.
Don't touch me.
Don't order me around, or I'll kill you.
Time to take out the garbage.
I will crush them in an instant.
How annoying. Begone.
Let's see just how strong these things are.
Talk about spoiling the mood.
Bah, just when things were getting good.
Patience. I'll slash you soon enough.
Meet your doom!
This is all for him!
Die!
Weak.
Pathetic.
Heh.
Damn!
Urgh!
Well done...!
Has my blade been dulled?
How terribly unexciting.

I'm experiencing all sorts of new things.
I can't believe another world exists... heh.

These Raptures are everywhere you turn.
They're such a nuisance.

The Ark... humanity's last bastion.
It's somewhat amusing to watch everyone struggle so hard to survive.
Am I the only one who came?

I'm glad those irksome individuals didn't tag along.
It gives me one less thing to worry about.
I must return to his side.

This landscape is familiar, that's for sure.
Hehe, perhaps this world is worth exploring after all.

The scent of wood and earth.
It's been so long.
This place makes me uncomfortable.

A man-made underground paradise...
I don't like it.
If I stay here any longer, I'm gonna end up breaking everything.

I must kill EVE.
I cannot allow such a pathetic being to stand beside him.
The greater the strength, the better.

Did I surpass another limit?
Heh. How fun!
With this strength, EVE is mine!
I have no use for this.
Quit giving me such pointless things.
Take it back.
Hmm...
Stop lingering around me.
... Don't come near me.
Time to hunt.
What is this?
I'll move when I want to. Leave me be.
Let's start.
The perfect time to kick back and relax.
You're all nothing but heaps of scrap metal.
Let me introduce you to death.
Wait right there.
Your life's extended for a few more seconds.
Reloading.
Time to die.
I will slice through all of you!
Heh! Struggle all you want!
Hindrance.
Get lost.
Hmph.
Ugh...!
What the...?!
Agh...!
To face my downfall here... of all places!
I wasted my time. Moving on.
